title: Batching policy inspector — incremental probes
content:
Purpose
This note captures the plan and early instrumentation for a set of incremental probes to evaluate how small, controlled changes to continuous-batching policies affect tail latency, fairness between tenants, and end-to-end cost per token. The goal is to produce quick, actionable signals we can use to prioritize a follow-up ablation sweep.

Context
We observe occasional P99 spikes under mixed-tenant synthetic load. Previous exploratory runs pointed at interactions between prefill behavior, age-based urgency, and per-tenant soft-quota steering. This doc is intended to be a lightweight runbook + experiment matrix for the next two weeks.

High-level objectives
- Surface which batching knobs materially move P95/P99 under production-like arrival patterns.
- Measure per-tenant fairness (latency skew between small and large tenants) and the rate of SLA violations.
- Capture telemetry signals that correlate with tail events so future CI checks can guard regressions.

Definitions / signals we will collect
- tail_latency_ms: P95, P99, P999 measured at request granularity (end-to-end server-side).
- queue_time_ms: time between request enqueue and batch dispatch.
- batch_size_at_dispatch: number of requests in a dispatched batch.
- prefill_fraction: fraction of batch tokens attributable to KV-prefill (if applicable).
- tenant_latency_skew: median(latency_small_tenant)/median(latency_large_tenant) per window.
- drop_rate_pct: fraction of requests shed by batch-shedding heuristics.
- scheduler_backpressure: token-credit ledger depth and number of blocked slots.
- cost_per_1k_tokens_est: proxy derived from avg batch size and GPU occupancy metrics.

Experiment matrix (incremental probes)
Each probe runs for a 2-hour steady-state replay using benchctl replay harness (see commands). We'll start on a single node pool then expand to a 3-node pool if results are marginal.
Variants (A–D):
A) Aggressive-prefill: prefill_threshold=0.8, prefill_prio=true, max_group_age_ms=6
B) Conservative-timeout: per-slot-timeout_ms=18, prefill_threshold=0.25, max_group_age_ms=14
C) Age-decay-fairness: age_weight_exponent=1.8, tenant_demote_after_ms=220, fairness_boost=0.12
D) Quota-steering: soft_quota_window=30s, steer_strength=0.4, prefill_threshold=0.4
Control: current prod-snapshot config (recorded in experiment metadata).

Traffic profile and inputs
- Use the synthetic arrival trace derived from 2025-01-24 production replay (trace id: replay-2025-01-24-mix). This includes: 60% small-tenant chat, 30% medium multi-turn, 10% long-form embeddings bursts.
- Token length distribution: median 48 tokens, 95th percentile 520 tokens.
- For each run we will scale qps to target 85% GPU utilization observed in prior load-tests.

Instrumentation checklist (what to add or verify before running)
- Ensure benchctl replay includes microtrace-level headers (x-bench-trace-id).
- Expose per-batch annotations: batch_id, list of tenant_ids (sampled up to 10), kernel_time_ms, prefill_tokens.
- Add a short-lived prometheus job to scrape scheduler internal gauges at 1s resolution: queue_len_by_ttl, idle_fill_rate, prefill_counters.
- Ensure logging at INFO for batch-formation events with correlation ids.

Run commands (bench harness + k8s snippets)
- benchctl replay --trace replay-2025-01-24-mix --duration 2h --target-util 0.85 --out-dir /tmp/probe-A
- kubectl apply -f experiments/scheduler-probe-configs/probe-A.yaml
- kubectl logs -f -l app=serving-runtime -c scheduler --since=2h | tee /tmp/probe-A-scheduler.log
- python tools/analyze_probe.py --input /tmp/probe-A --metrics tail_latency_ms,queue_time_ms,tenant_latency_skew --out /tmp/probe-A-results.json

Analysis plan
- Primary: compare P99 and P999 across variants and control; flag any variant with P99 > control + 15%.
- Secondary: compute fairness delta = P95_small_tenant - P95_large_tenant; prioritize variants that reduce this delta without increasing P99 for the global traffic.
- Cost proxy: estimate cost_per_1k_tokens_est; if a variant reduces P99 but increases cost_per_1k_tokens_est by >12%, demote it.
- Use bootstrap confidence intervals (1k resamples) to judge significance of P99 shifts.

Acceptance criteria (for promoting a config to broader rollout)
- P99 reduced by at least 8% vs control AND P95 unchanged or improved.
- tenant_latency_skew improves by at least 6%.
- Estimated cost_per_1k_tokens_est increases by <= 8% or decreases.
- No sustained increase in drop_rate_pct above 0.5%.

Early observations (from dry-run on local cluster)
- Aggressive-prefill (A) reduced average kernel_time_ms by ~5% but increased P99 by 12% (likely due to larger batches blocking small low-latency requests).
- Age-decay-fairness (C) reduced tenant_latency_skew by ~9% in 30m runs with negligible cost delta.
- Conservative-timeout (B) reduced small-tenant tail but raised drop_rate_pct slightly during microbursts.

Risks and mitigations
- Risk: A change that looks beneficial in synthetic replay could worsen under real production arrival covariance. Mitigation: run canary 2-node rollout with canary traffic routing and 1-hour rollback threshold.
- Risk: telemetry overhead masking the very signals we measure. Mitigation: sample microtraces to 10% and validate sampled vs unsampled distributions in a short run.

Next steps and schedule
- Day 0 (today): finalize probe configs and confirm bench harness works with new batch annotations (owner: Aisha).
- Day 1: run A/B/C/D 2h runs sequentially on staging node pool (owners: Liam + Sofia).
- Day 2: run expanded 3-node set and longer 6h stability run for top 2 candidates (owners: Ethan + Aisha).
- Day 3: prepare canary rollout plan and write-up for product/observability (deliverable: probe-run-results.md).

Open questions for the group
- Should we instrument per-kernel GPU occupancy per batch or rely on node-level GPU metrics? (Pros: finer signal; Cons: more intrusive.)
- Is tenant demotion acceptable for enterprise customers with SLA-backed latency? Need input from SRE/product.

Appendix: quick config snippets
- probe-A (Aggressive-prefill):
  prefill_threshold: 0.8
  prefill_prio: true
  max_group_age_ms: 6

- probe-C (Age-decay-fairness):
  age_weight_exponent: 1.8
  tenant_demote_after_ms: 220
  fairness_boost: 0.12

Contact
- For questions ping #eng-serving-runtime or DM Aisha Patel.

End of note.
